about: E9-C (plan §19C.10, §19C.15): Chrome background-service items added to the offline proof's baseline after a run stopped on them. Each is non-speech, was refused by the local proxy, and is added by a dated deviation note committed before the run resumed. Items that mention speech are refused by the tool.

additions.evidence: Run stopped 10 s after arming on 'POST update.googleapis.com' (proxy host without port). Its NetLog URL, http://update.googleapis.com/service/update2/json, is already in the baseline of chrome-ondevice-offline-proof_3545bda.json; the host fell outside that proof's proxy baseline only because the request landed inside a cloud-control window. NetLog after arming: 0 speech URLs; only update2/json URLs.
